instruction.text: Hassan and Layla are talking about body parts. Listen to what each person has to say. Is it correct?

atoms.a: My toes are at the end of my feet.

end.sound: Yes! Hassan has five toes at the end of each foot.

atoms.a: My face has one eye and two noses.

end.sound: ssml: No! Her face has two eyes and one nose.

atoms.a: My neck connects my arms to my legs.

end.sound: No! Hassan’s neck connects his head to his shoulders and chest.

atoms.a: I have two legs and two feet.

end.sound: Yes! Legs and feet help you to walk around.

instruction.text: Emily and Luke are talking about body parts. Listen to what each person has to say. Is it correct?

atoms.a: My fingers are at the end of my feet.

end.sound: ssml: No! Emily’s fingers are at the end of her hands. Toes are at the end of her feet.

atoms.a: I have two arms that are attached to the side of my head.

end.sound: ssml: No! Ears are attached to the side of your head. Arms are attached to the side of your chest.

atoms.a: My face has two eyes and one nose.

end.sound: ssml: Yes! Your eyes help you to see and your nose helps you to smell.

atoms.a: My neck connects my head to my chest and to my shoulders.

end.sound: ssml: Yes! Your neck is a very important body part!

atoms.a: I have four arms and four legs.

end.sound: No! Emily has two arms and two legs.
